items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was one man, the colored fellow had a band I heard of, Manuel Perez. ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's the man. Manuel Perez. That's the boy.

ctx.x: There was one man, the colored fellow had a band I heard of, Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez is a man. That's the man?
That's the man. Manuel Perez. That's the boy.
I mean Manuel had a good band.
